req.title: Reject negative skip
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the skip parameter is negative.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-006 requires HTTP 422 when skip < 0. The violations were test[3] and test[4] having kind=negative but heuristic=EP. The rule requires that negative-kind tests use NEG (or BVA/DT/STC) rather than EP, since EP is reserved for positive equivalence partition tests. Fix: change test[3] (skip=-2) heuristic from EP to NEG, and test[4] (skip=-9999) heuristic from EP to NEG. All other tests are preserved exactly as they were.

tests.name: test_skip_negative_one_returns_422
expected: Response body contains validation error detail
trace: R-TASK-006: system shall respond with HTTP 422 when skip parameter is negative
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_skip_negative_one_returns_422():
    r = client.get("/tasks/?skip=-1")
    assert r.status_code == 422
    body = r.json()
    assert "detail" in body
    detail_str = str(body["detail"])
    assert "skip" in detail_str.lower() or "greater" in detail_str.lower() or "ge" in detail_str.lower() or len(body["detail"]) > 0

tests.name: test_skip_boundary_minus_one_vs_zero

trace: R-TASK-006: BVA at ge=0 boundary; catches off-by-one mutations (ge->gt would reject 0, gt->ge would accept -1)
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_skip_boundary_minus_one_vs_zero():
    r_neg = client.get("/tasks/?skip=-1")
    assert r_neg.status_code == 422

    r_zero = client.get("/tasks/?skip=0")
    assert r_zero.status_code == 200
    body_zero = r_zero.json()
    assert isinstance(body_zero, list)
    assert len(body_zero) == 20

    r_one = client.get("/tasks/?skip=1")
    assert r_one.status_code == 200
    body_one = r_one.json()
    assert isinstance(body_one, list)
    assert len(body_one) == 19

tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_skip_large_negative_returns_422():
    r = client.get("/tasks/?skip=-9999")
    assert r.status_code == 422
    body = r.json()
    assert "detail" in body
    assert isinstance(body["detail"], list)
    assert len(body["detail"]) >= 1
    loc_found = any(
        "skip" in str(err.get("loc", ""))
        for err in body["detail"]
        if isinstance(err, dict)
    )
    assert loc_found

tests.name: test_skip_negative_response_structure
actions: Inspect response JSON structure for FastAPI validation error format
expected: Response JSON has key 'detail' which is a list
First error entry has 'type' indicating a value constraint violation
trace: R-TASK-006: validates exact error payload structure, not just status code; kills mutations that return wrong status or empty body
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_skip_negative_response_structure():
    r = client.get("/tasks/?skip=-1")
    assert r.status_code == 422
    body = r.json()
    assert "detail" in body
    detail = body["detail"]
    assert isinstance(detail, list)
    assert len(detail) == 1
    err = detail[0]
    assert isinstance(err, dict)
    assert "loc" in err
    assert "skip" in err["loc"]
    assert "type" in err
    assert err["type"] == "greater_than_equal"
